_desc: Fix-1 regression (distinct-origination anti-spam metric, §10a). Link alice<->bob is tuned so the SF8 routing RTS/CTS decode but the forced SF7 DATA does not (SNR -9 dB; SF7 demod needs -7.5, SF8 -10). alice sends TWO distinct messages to bob. msg-one's DATA never lands, so alice retries the SAME RTS (ctr_lo=1) several times; bob (originator_max_per_window=2, originator_retry_dedup_ms=200 so the track-side dedup does NOT collapse the retries) observes them. Under the OLD raw RTS-count metric those retries push apparent_origination past 2, so when msg-two (ctr_lo=2) arrives alice is already throttled and bob silently drops it (no CTS for ctr_lo=2). Under the fix, compute_originator_metric counts DISTINCT ctr_lo, so msg-one's retries count as 1; msg-two brings the distinct total to 2 (not >2) and bob still CTSes it. Verify: alice retried msg-one (rts_retry), and bob CTSed msg-two (cts_tx ctr_lo=2) — i.e. the retry storm did not throttle a genuinely-distinct second origination.
